## Summary

**New API in `pageserver/src/tenant/timeline/layer_manager.rs`:**
- Added a `pub(crate) enum LayerManagerLockHolder` identifying who acquires the lock, with a `Testing` variant plus semantic variants (`GetLayerMapInfo`, `GenerateHeatmap`, `GetPage`, `Init`, `GetLayerForWrite`, `TryFreezeLayer`, `FlushFrozenLayer`, `Compaction`, `GarbageCollection`, `Eviction`, `DetachAncestor`, `ImportPgData`, `Shutdown`).
- Added guard type aliases `LayerManagerReadGuard` / `LayerManagerWriteGuard`.
- Added a `LockedLayerManager` wrapper (deriving `Default`) around the existing `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>`, exposing:
  - `async fn read(holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerReadGuard` (i.e. `-> impl Future<Output = LayerManagerReadGuard>`)
  - `async fn write(holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerWriteGuard`
  - plus `try_read`/`try_write` taking the same holder, since those are also existing lock-acquisition call sites.

**Wiring:**
- Changed `Timeline::layers` field type from `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` to `LockedLayerManager` (the `Default::default()` initializer still works).

**Callers updated** across all source files (~70 call sites): `timeline.rs`, `tenant.rs`, `mgr.rs`, `compaction.rs`, `detach_ancestor.rs`, `eviction_task.rs`, `analysis.rs`, `import_pgdata.rs`, `import_pgdata/flow.rs`, `http/routes.rs`, `storage_layer/delta_layer.rs`, and `storage_layer/layer/tests.rs`. Each passes a context-appropriate variant; all `#[cfg(test)]` contexts use `LayerManagerLockHolder::Testing` (e.g. `timeline.layers.read(LayerManagerLockHolder::Testing).await`).
